verdict.rationale: macOS ships Shortcuts (macos-docs-19) which can be scheduled/triggered to run automations, and Spotlight can trigger actions (macos-docs-15), providing basic OS-level automation capability, but there's no evidence of AI-native autonomous background agent orchestration, scheduling depth, or hands-on validation of reliability for unattended automation. Missing for 10: documentation of scheduled/triggered background execution specifics, AI-agent integration, independent corroboration of reliability for autonomous background tasks.
